page.layout: One printed page, single text block with brace diagrams inline. Running head top left and top right. Page number centred at the top. Signature and catchword at the foot. Left edge shows the neighbouring page, not transcribed. No marginal notes on this page.

main_text.l: Desperationis est cùm rectè animus sui pendet.
Timoris est qua animus rectè ex impendenti malo
lum sit turpitudo, pudor dicitur. Marc.8.38. Quod
Vagarum sanctitas est cùm animus rectè affici-
tur erga bonum & malum certò vel incertò futu-
Desiderij sanctitas, est cùm animus rectè appetit

l.i: Atq; huiusmodi est sanctitas simplicium affectionum:

main_text.l: Mixtarum sanctitas est, cùm animus rectè
afficitur, circa bonum & malum, præsens, præteritum
Amoris sanctitas, est qua animus ex boni præsétis

page.notes: Brace diagrams were rendered as outline lines; the outer brace grouping is approximate. The word "Estq;" is read with some doubt. The left edge strip belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out.
